steps.content: A cold droplet falls on your forehead, sharp with the scent of disinfectant. Harsh incandescent lights sting your eyes. You try to move, but your limbs are locked down, firmly strapped to a hospital bed.
You wrench your head to the side. The room before you is less an operating theater and more a morgue.
The floor is a chaotic sprawl of white body bags, too many to count. And in the center, restrained on a dissection table, is Hilda. She is surrounded by specters—formless, nameless things.

steps.speaker: Approaching Mania
steps.content: Liar... Liar! You stole our future with your lies... and now you dare try to take our only hope!

They weep and scream, their fingernails elongated into surgical scalpels. They shred everything around them, then turn on themselves and each other, gouging out organs, trading hearts for hearts and blood for blood, only to reassemble in an instant. A perpetual, self-inflicted hell.
Of Hilda, not a single part remains intact.

And then you see her, Nolaine's face, adrift in the chaos. The girl's once-unyielding, earnest gaze has been honed into the sharpest of blades. It carves directly into the deepest recesses of the heart of the person she once admired most.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: I hate you, Hilda. I hate you for making us believe...

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: I followed you. I admired you. I swore I would dedicate my life to the city-state, just like you.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: And now you tell us it was all wrong? That the metropoles are corrupt, that my loyalty was pledged to evil, that it was all meaningless?!

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: You built the foundation of our faith, and now you want to shatter it with your own hands?! Don't you dare!!
Don't you dare!!
Their voices—a chorus of profound resentment, agonizing pain, and burning rage—echo through the empty room.

They surge toward you in a snarling wave, pushing your bed until it jars to a halt beside the cold dissection table. Claws, sharp and gleaming, point accusingly at you, while their burning gazes turn to interrogate the silent Hilda.

steps.speaker: Ghosts
steps.content: You brought this outsider here to do what? To turn back now? To fix your mistakes? After you led us this far? After so many were sacrificed?

steps.speaker: Ghosts
steps.content: Do you think this is salvation? No! This is annihilation! You want to destroy everything, and save only yourself!

steps.speaker: Ghosts
steps.content: We died for you!! And now you call us "wrong"?!

steps.speaker: Ghosts
steps.content: Are you trying to make fools of us?!!
With a collective roar, they carve open their own chests with vicious blades. They tear out their deceived hearts and hurl the still-beating organs at you and Hilda.

steps.speaker: Ghosts
steps.content: Look! Look at our hearts! You defiled them! You betrayed us!
The shapeless, bloody masses slam into you, bursting apart and splattering your bodies with pitch-black Mania. The corrupting energy immediately seeps into your skin like a cold, invasive poison.
You stand transfixed before these young, blindly devoted souls.

They once lived convinced of their righteous path, sacrificing themselves for the glory of the metropoles, only to have that conviction shattered in death. Now, in a final, futile gesture, they carve out their own hearts, seeking answers they can no longer hold.
They advance, a haunting procession. In one hand, they hold their bleeding hearts like sacred offerings. In the other, they level their blades squarely at Hilda's chest.

steps.speaker: Ghosts
steps.content: Cut it out! See her heart! See her true face! See if it's as pure and spotless as she claims! CUT IT OUT!!
